# Causal Link

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CausalLink`](gmeow-CausalLink.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CausalLink>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

A reified type-level causal claim — antecedent kind × consequent kind × modality, with optional mechanism prose and solver-input strength. Mint one when HOW the causation works must be first-class; the 80% case stays flat [`gmeow:typeCauses`](../properties/gmeow-typeCauses.md) (reify-on-demand, [Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)). Whose claim it is rides the statement layer; two analysts' divergent links coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CausalLink`](gmeow-CausalLink.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
